$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

AbsentReason.description: Why a value is absent (spec 032, 3.4.3 and 3.6.2).

Action.description:
Who can act on an outcome or notice, how, why, and whether retrying the
same request can succeed (3.5.2). Every member is always written.

caused_by.description: Duplicate-free, sorted by each cause's canonical JSON bytes.

AsOf.description: The oldest as-of among contributing graded values, or `none`.

oneOf.description: A valid output.
The decision deadline passed while it was in flight.
The caller cancelled while it was in flight.

attempt_id.description:
`<decision id>/<step>/<instance ids joined by ','>/<n>`, each
component with `%`, `/` and `,` percent-escaped.

Basis.description: How a value's metadata came about (spec 032, 3.2.2).

oneOf.description: An item supplied by an acquisition source (spec 036, 3.4.6).
An input.
An exact step or the policy.
An input whose disagreement a declared rule resolved.

BatchMembership.description: An attempt's place in a batched exchange.

oneOf.description: The backend confirmed that its work and charges stopped.
The backend answered without confirming a remote stop.
The runtime stopped waiting before any answer.

Cancellation.description: What is known about cancelling an attempt (spec 003, 3.7.3).

CapabilityStep.description: A fallback field identifies the extraction step (spec 038, 3.12.3).

Cause.description: One cause of an outcome or notice (3.5.2).

CauseProvenance.description: The provenance an input cause records (3.5.2).

oneOf.description: An accepted entry existed (including a dropped or invalid one).
No entry did: the classes the input accepts.

Charge.description: What an attempt cost, as far as is known when it ends.

ChargeProvenance.description: How the attempt's charge was established.

oneOf.description: Reported by the remote side for this attempt's own exchange.
A share of a batched exchange's reported charge.
No request byte left the process: nothing was charged.
Not known; the reservation stays liability.

reason.description: Why a check is `no_evidence`, or its declared `on_false`.

oneOf.description: The predicate was true.
The predicate was false; the declared `on_false` applied.
A read was unresolved or absent.
A read's grade is below `upgrade_to`.
Exactly what the core's `finish` returned.

Corroboration.description:
A corroboration step's record: the claim before and after, the outcome
and every check.

CostBound.description: A backend's per-call cost disclosure, before dispatch.

oneOf.description: The call cannot cost more than this.

CostSummary.description: A decision's cost at the moment its record was built (spec 003, 3.5.6).

liability.description: Reservations kept because the final cost is unknown.

within_guaranteed_cap.description: True only under `hard` with no liability and no bound violation.

Disclosure.description: What a served identity is worth (spec 009, 3.7).

oneOf.description: The remote side guarantees the identity.
The remote side said so; unverified.
Nothing is known. Never replaced by a requested model or a slug.

EntryEvidence.description: One snapshot entry considered for a graded input.

checks.description:
Evidence 2 with `actionability`: every check, in declaration order
(spec 033, 3.4.8).

decision_id.description: Per execution, supplied by the caller; not a digest.

screening.description: One record per screened value, in lowered-step and item order.

EvidenceUnavailable.description:
Why an attempt's exchange record cannot be named (spec 020, 3.2): stated,
never reconstructed.

oneOf.description: Nothing was exchanged: the attempt was refused before any request.
The exchange had not ended when the record was built.
The exchange sink refused or failed the record.
The exchange sink accepted the record but named no locator.

ExchangeReference.description: Where the exchange record of an attempt is, or why it cannot be named.

locator.description: An opaque host reference, never a URL with credentials.

FailureClass.description:
How a dispatched attempt failed (spec 003, 3.6.1). Deadline and
cancellation are not classes: they end a request, and are never retried
or a fallback trigger.

oneOf.description: The output failed the core's validation.
The adapter says the failure may not recur.
The adapter says the backend refused for load.
The adapter says the failure will recur for this input.
The attempt timeout passed.
The adapter panicked.

counts.description: How many items each rule excluded.

Grade.description:
The closed, ordered evidence grade. The derived order runs weakest to
strongest, so `min` and `max` are the grade order of spec 032, 3.2.1.

oneOf.description:
A label from a source declared unreliable for that field, or a
constructed key not yet corroborated.
A computed or crawled approximation that never was authoritative.
Was authoritative at its as-of time and has not been revalidated.
Live, attested by the system that owns the fact.

dropped.description:
Evidence 2: the check whose `drop_field` made this input absent; its
entry digest, source and provenance stay recorded (spec 033, 3.4.8).

entries.description: Evidence 2, graded inputs: every entry considered, in snapshot order.

resolution.description: Evidence 2: how a disagreement was resolved (spec 032, 3.8.4).

trace.description: Which handler, rule and adjustments produced the outcome, in order.

Lineage.description: What a value was computed from: input fields and steps, sorted.

MergeEvidence.description: One merged field: its side (or why it is absent), rule and grade.

item.description: The item id when merging per item; empty for two records.

MergeSide.description: Which side of a merge a field came from (spec 032, 3.6.3).

action.description: Judgment 2: who can act on it (spec 033, 3.5.4); omitted in version 1.

screening.description: Entry, field, consequence and item ids only (spec 035, 3.6.4).

subject.description: The step or policy item it concerns.

oneOf.description: Spec 033, 3.3: a check's field-level consequences.

The output of an attempt shared with concurrent equivalent requests
(spec 044, 3.2.5).

The persistent request-level tier behind the host's store (spec
044, 3.3 and 3.4).

OptimizationRecord.description:
Per-logical-request runtime observations. Secret key material and cached
content are deliberately absent.

diagnostics.description:
Every refusal or diagnostic, in the order observed, at most
[`MAX_OPTIMIZATION_DIAGNOSTICS`].

shared.description: This request's part in a shared call (spec 044, 3.2.5).

source_attempt_id.description:
The attempt that produced the supplied output. For a cache hit it is
an attempt of an earlier decision, and the record has no attempt of
its own; replay takes it as the output's origin.

Origin.description: Who registered a backend (3.9): `upstream` unless the host implements it.

OutValue.description: A value placed in a proposal's parameters.

oneOf.description: The `none` of a `maybe` value.

Outcome.description:
A judgment's outcome. Version 1 uses `Propose`, `Escalate` and
`Unresolved`; version 2 (spec 033, 3.5.1) replaces `Unresolved` with
`UnresolvedAction` and adds `Refused` and `NeedsInput`. Both unresolved
forms share the wire key `unresolved`: `{"unresolved": <reason>}` in
version 1, `{"unresolved": {"reason": <reason>, "action": <action>}}` in
version 2.

Override.description: `none`, or the party an author moved the outcome to and why.

Party.description:
Who can act on an outcome (3.5.2), ordered from most to least able to
act on it themselves: the combination of parties is the greatest.

Presence.description: A value's presence status. Key existence alone is never presence.

predicate.description: The canonical predicate that failed, for `predicate_failed`.

PresentWhen.description:
A record presence predicate (spec 032, 3.4.2). Each list is non-empty;
the canonical form sorts and deduplicates every field list.

ProvenanceClass.description: The closed set of provenance classes (spec 002, 3.7.1).

fields.description: A non-empty subset of the outcome's fields.

text.description: 1 to 1024 bytes of UTF-8, carried byte-identical; no interpolation.

Ranking.description: A `RankPosition` in wire form: an order, not a probability of being best.

excluded.description: Candidates left out because a component was unresolved.

digest.description: Absent when the read has no value (it was unresolved or absent).

Refusal.description: One refusing check of a `refused` outcome (3.5.1).

Remediation.description:
A remediation as an action carries it: `none`, or a code and its
canonical parameters (3.6.1).

RemediationValue.description:
A scalar or list value in a remediation's parameters: the subset of
`OutValue` (spec 002) a remediation can carry, in the same wire form.

RemoteCode.description:
The closed error taxonomy (spec 009, 3.6). Each code maps to exactly one
spec 003 failure class; the mapping lives with the adapters, because the
failure classes of the backend seam are not contract types.

RemoteEvidence.description:
One remote attempt's evidence reference in `rustev.run/2` (spec 020,
3.2, I-4). It names the exchange record, never embeds it: no request or
response body, credential, secret address, unredacted principal
reference, provider reasoning or header.

batch.description: Present when the attempt was a member of a batched exchange.

binding.description:
The adapter binding (its artifact), the protocol or foreign mapping
version, and the endpoint class (never a secret URL).

code.description: The remote error code of a failed attempt.

principal_digest.description: The principal reference's evidence digest, only when one was sent.

remote_state.description: The attempt's final remote state, as the run record has it.

requested_identity.description: What the adapter asked for; `None` when it names no model.

step.description: The decision step and logical request (instance) the attempt served.

oneOf.description: The backend returned a result of its own accord.
The backend acknowledged a cancellation as stopped.
Nothing establishes that remote work or charges stopped.

optimization.description: Absent for unoptimized execution, preserving existing record bytes.

oneOf.description: An output was supplied, from this target (0 is the bound backend).
This runtime reason was supplied.
Nothing was supplied: the decision was cancelled first.

Resolution.description: The rule applied to a disagreement and what it chose.

ResolutionRule.description:
The conflict rule applied (spec 032, 3.8.1); the source order of
`prefer` and `treat_as_hint` is the plan's.

RetentionClass.description: What the host retained of an exchange.

oneOf.description: The record with digests only (spec 009, 3.9.3).
The record and the request and response bytes.

ScreeningEvidence.description: One screened value's evidence, in lowered-step and item order.

item.description: Null means this field is not a list item.

ScreeningNotice.description: Details of a screening notice. Never includes screened text.

SharedLeave.description: Why a waiter left before the shared attempt ended.

SharedRecord.description:
One waiter's view of a shared call. Waiter ids are opaque and
runtime-generated, never decision ids, so a tenant-only scope exposes no
principal's decisions to another (spec 044, decision 5).

truncated.description: Eligible ids not kept because of `k`.

join.description: Evidence 2, `join_keyed@1`: each entry's id and match status.

oneOf.description: Every request resolved and the core finished a judgment.
The caller cancelled; no judgment was finished.

Timing.description: Monotonic milliseconds from submission; never wall-clock time.

oneOf.description: Retry the same target after attempt `after`.
Move to fallback target `to` after attempt `after`.
Stop after attempt `after` (0 when nothing was dispatched).

Unresolved.description:
The closed set of unresolved reasons (spec 002, 3.5.6). Field and fact
lists are sorted and deduplicated.

oneOf.description: A read whose value is below a required grade (spec 032, 3.9.4).
Unscreened fields a model step would read (spec 035, 3.9.1).

UnresolvedWire.description:
Version 2's `{reason, action}` is tried first; no version 1 reason is
named `reason` or `action`, so the two forms never overlap.

oneOf.description: Index into the input's `entries`.

ValueGrade.description:
A value's grade, or `ungraded` when no graded value contributed.
`ungraded` is not a point of the grade order (spec 032, 3.2.3).

ValueMeta.description:
Value metadata (spec 032, 3.2.2): carried by every input and step value
of a plan 3 evaluation. A record carries one per field, a list one per
item and a map one per entry, in the optional members.

decision_id.description: Supplied by the caller; the delivery key sinks deduplicate by.

remote_evidence.description:
`rustev.run/2` only (spec 020, 3.2): at most one entry per remote
attempt, in attempt order, at most [`MAX_REMOTE_EVIDENCE`]. Absent in
every other version, so their bytes are unchanged.

remote_evidence_truncated.description: `rustev.run/2` only: remote attempts beyond the bound have no entry.

requests.description: In the order the core listed them.

title: rustev.run/2
